title: Fantastic
text:
Absolutely fantastic show and the Tapas meal was plentiful.
A fantastic evening spent with friends..
author: Kelly_A

title: We debated between a...
text:
We debated between a shorter or longer flamenco experience. This is perfect if you are traveling with kids.  

The dancing 🕺 💃 was superb! What athleticism! The guitar and singing were also phenomenal! 

The tapas and sangria after the show were plentiful and delicious.  We were stuffed!
author: Gisela_S

title: Amazing experience
text: This was amazing. You meet at the travelers bar then your hostess walked you over to the flamenco show on the walk she told you some history on Barcelona that was very informative we had 3 older people with us and they had no problems walking over and then back to the bar.  They made us non alcoholic sangria and were very accommodating and the tapas were all amazing. So yummy.  I would highly recommend
author: robert_m

title: Tapas and food what a good patch!
text: I really liked the flamenco event and the rich tapas! Good quality! Abundant! It is noticeable and they strive for the attention by the tourist. Very well attended and the sangria rich. The flamenco show was very punctual and good.
author: Diego_C

title: Great expérience in Barcelona do not miss
text:
Excellent.
Dany excellent host, took care of us very well fell like V.I.P. The show is amazing, lot of émotions between the 5 of them, very nice complicity, the Tapas are excellent, too much for us with an excellent homemade sangria
author: Dreamer814270

title: Best tour and food
text: The show was so awesome and worth every  euro.  The tour of the area was great and short walk to eat.  Every dish was great and plenty of it.  Must do.
author: Victoria_D

title: Enjoyed the show and the...
text: Enjoyed the show and the food afterwards, especially the unlimited Sangria! The meeting point was the Travellers  Nest bar, from there, we walked a short distance to the place where the show was. It was a nice walk through the plaza and the flamenco dancers and musicians were very talented!
author: ynyherrera

title: Definitely worth the price and entertainment
text:
Worth the price- The flamenco dance is a must see. 
Tapas was a wonderful variety and great experience.
author: David_T

title: Great tour
text: Very interesting history, knowledgeable and personable guide. Memorable experience. I would recommend it.
author: Olga_P

title: Excellent
text: Very moving…excellent. Would do it again! Very easy to find and our guide was great. Tapas after the show were outstanding.
author: Norine_B
